name: if it's by my hand
source:
The news breaks to a town that's completely unready to hear it.

A terrible, tragic murder while the town slept, targeting poor, innocent students from the local high school... Everyone assumed that it was a clear-cut case of a monster targeting some unfortunate victims...

...what a joke.

[From [url=https://cowboy-starshine.itch.io/if-its-by-my-hand]Itch.io[/url]]
